$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the photography-family pack composed with a newborn and motherhood photographer's content seed (Ada Lin, Seattle), re-registered in the milkglass register (the daylight newborn studio) with its own pinned page skeletons — the seed's `home.layout: "builder"` makes the base builders emit one full-bleed window photograph over the session builder (pricing `builder` with `builderLayout: "tiles"`). Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests, booking and proofing — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Ada Lin — Newborn & Motherhood Photography
description: A Seattle newborn and motherhood photographer's site in the milkglass register (milk white and sage, a thin book serif over a light grotesque): the studio's name in thin spaced capitals over one full-bleed photograph of a mother and her newborn at a rain-soft window — The first weeks, held in light. — then a session builder: choose one session (newborn in the studio, motherhood, Fresh 48 at the hospital), tick keepsakes (a linen heirloom album, fine-art prints, the digital gallery) and extras (siblings, grandparents) as photograph tiles, and watch the summary card total the session beside a Reserve your due date button. Then a selected-work wall, the photographer, the collections, one voice, and a closing banner. REAL booking (a newborn planning call, a motherhood session, a studio visit on the studio's weekday calendar), private code-gated client proofing on the platform proofing service with a sample room, an FAQ, and an inquiry form — a multi-page site edited in one content file.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so this appointments seed replaces the base pack's at compose and mirrors THIS remix's contentSeed module codeAppointments entry for entry (the remix-seed test pins the twin) — the composed template's Manage session calendar and booking widget open on the documentary offering: the half day books straight off the weekend calendar; full days and day-in-the-life days start with a planning call because they run past the booking domain's 240-minute slot ceiling. One provider: a one-photographer studio.

theme.$comment: The milkglass register's brand overlay: mode light opens the site in its native milk-white daylight appearance (the appearance toggle still swaps to the night-feed dark reading), and the register's sage rides as the project brand so app-side surfaces (the code-gated proofing room's chrome and controls) wear the same register as the marketing pages instead of the kernel default blue. Values match the milkglass preset's own light/dark accents — the marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so keeping them identical means the overlay re-brands the app without shifting the pages.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the milkglass register (the daylight newborn studio: milk white and sage, Spectral over Work Sans, the name in thin spaced capitals, the session builder as photograph tiles beside a serif total), and pages carries exactly the skeletons familyLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the builder home (a full-bleed hero, the session builder, the selected-work wall, the photographer, the collections, one voice, the booking banner) — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/PhotographyFamily/familyLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
